subject: Pilot timeline risk — integration regression blocking demo
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha@avatech.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Paul Ng <paul.ng@avatech.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timeline risk — integration regression blocking demo

Hi Olga,

Quick note from our engineering team: we hit a regresssion in the adapter that integrates Ava’s event webhook payloads with Redwood’s ingestion endpoint. The failure started showing up after our last schema refactor (see attached log snippet). Because of this, our demo that was scheduled for next Wednesday is at risk — the team estimates a 7–10 day fix and an extra 2–3 days of verification across staging.

We really want to keep momentum, but we’re running low on the pilot credits and our sandbox window ends on 2026-09-16. Is there a process to get a short runway extension or a small credit top‑up while we get this patched? We can share a short mutual action plan as well (will attach once I have it finalized).

Appreciate any help — Sasha / Samantha

Attachments: integration-log-2026-09-09.txt (log excerpt)

--
Samantha Li
Head of Engineering, Ava Technologies
samantha@avatech.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@avatech.com>
Cc: Paul Ng <paul.ng@avatech.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline risk — integration regression blocking demo

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the log. I glanced through the snippet and I can see why the team is blocked.

Provisional offer: we can pause your sandbox expiration for 14 days (new expiry 2026-09-30) and apply a 2,000-credit grant to the pilot to cover the verification cycles, pending internal approval. I’ll attach our mutual action plan template and loop in my CS and deals owner to confirm the credit.

If that works for you, please send the finalized MAP (one-pager with milestones + sign-off owners) and we’ll fast-track it. Also — do you have a preferred time for a quick triage call today or tomorrow so our engineer can look at the log with yours?

Olga
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0987

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v2.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot timeline risk — integration regression blocking demo — credit/extension ask

Ben / Marissa — forwarding a short request from Ava. TL;DR: their engineering team hit a schema regression after a refactor; demo at risk; sandbox expires 2026-09-16. Proposed customer ask: 14‑day sandbox pause (to 2026-09-30) + 2,000 pilot credits.

Why I recommend approving: they’re a strategic pilot (tight timeline to convert if the demo goes well), and the requested credits are in the low SKU for a standard pilot top‑up. Marissa, CS will need to own the sandbox pause and verification gating; Karhtik, can you confirm there are no quota or usage risk issues if we apply the credits and pause?

Requested approvals / actions:
- Ben: approve 2,000 credits and 14‑day expiry extension (I’ll confirm how we reflect this in the billing record)
- Marissa: CS to confirm gating and set the triage / verification playbook (I’ll coordinate)
- Karthik: quick technical sign-off on any infra-side changes (rate limits, KV cache)

I’ve attached the MAP template I sent to the customer. If you approve, I’ll confirm to Samantha and schedule the triage call.

Thanks — Olga

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v2.pdf

Hi Samantha — good news. Ben approved the request. We’ve applied a 14‑day sandbox pause (new expiry 2026-09-30) and added a 2,000‑credit promotional grant to your pilot account (visible in the console under Billing > Promotions). Marissa from CS will send the verification playbook and coordinate the triage call — can you and Paul share 30–45 minutes availability Monday or Tuesday morning (PDT)?

Next steps:
- Ava: send the finalized MAP (one page with owners & milestones) — I have the template attached if you want to use it.
- Marissa: will initiate sandbox pause and verification checklist (tracking ticket will be created)
- Karhtik: will stand by for the triage call and confirm no infra-side adjustments are needed

Thanks for the quick escalation and for sharing the logs. We’re looking forward to getting the demo back on track.

Best,
